CRM notes: 
- Account: Sentinel Compliance Labs (mid-size regtech focused on regulatory evidence and audit automation). Heavy emphasis on 'no egress' for certain environments.
- Primary ask: Private VPC with on-prem/air-gapped installer for regulated customers (hospitals, national regulators). Must support HSM-backed key usage and offline KMS integration.
- Security review status: Completed initial questionnaire; next is architecture security review (ASR) w/ their CISO team. They require: SSO (SAML IdP), audit logs forwarded to Splunk, monthly integrity attestations, and data residency guarantee (US-only for some customers).
- KMS/HSM: They prefer using their existing Thales Luna and HashiCorp Vault with auto-unseal. Need compatibility matrix and instructions for key rotation and manual key import. Also asked about bringing-your-own-HSM (BYOH) and whether Redwood supports remote attestations/PKI pins.
- Air-gapped variant specifics:
  * Need an offline installer tarball + package manifest (rpm/deb/container images) and signed checksums.
  * No outbound telemetry in the air-gapped profile; local logging to syslog + secure forwarder to SIEM.
  * Manual license activation flow (ticket-based) and support runbook for upgrades.
- Audit logging: Must have per-request audit trails, token-to-user mapping, and retention policy configurable per deployment (90/180/365 days). They want optional secure append-only storage and periodic log signing.
- Performance targets: For clinical summarization workload, p95 latency target 300ms for short prompts, throughput target 200 qps during business hours. Will accept lower concurrency in air-gapped POC but want benchmark scripts.
- Model routing: Need ability to pin models for regulated customers, fallback policy to quantized variant if GPU capacity constrained. Asked about model provenance and checksum verification for open models.
- Quote from CISO: "We cannot allow any unmanaged key material outside our HSM. Show us a path where Redwood's control plane never sees unwrapped keys."
- POC plan (agreed): 3 phases -> 1) Security review + offline installer delivery, 2) On-prem deployment in sandbox network (customer-managed), HSM integration and audit log forwarding, 3) Acceptance tests: egress verification, key rotation test, latency/throughput benchmark.
- Legal/procurement: Wants template SLA (uptime + data residency). Procurement flagged commitment on support windows and RTO for critical incidents.
- Action items assigned: Jordan to deliver on-prem architecture pack and signed manifest; Priya to produce KMS/HSM compatibility note and sample manifests; SE to provide benchmark harness and upgrade runbook.
- Internal notes: Consider creating a hardened air-gapped install profile for future reuse. Flag for engineering: need documented manual upgrade path and signed artifact pipeline.
- Next call planned: 2026-03-01 infra deep-dive (30-60m) with their platform ops + CISO.
